@everyone CHARITY STREAM IS SAT NOV 21 🍞

10am to 10pm, 12 hours, all for the Linden Community Pantry. posting this early bc last year half of u found out the day of and we ended at $212. not this time

**goal: $600**
and tj_rook is matching the first $100 so the first 100 bucks basically counts double. thank u rook fr

**donate here:** lindenpantry.example/mrkz
it goes straight to the pantry, nothing gets taken off. denise from the pantry said every $1 = about 4 lbs of food bc of their wholesale partner. they're feeding around 340 families a week rn and she said the shelves are the lowest she's seen before thanksgiving. so yeah it actually matters

**incentives (mods cooked):**
$100 → i play a full round with the controller upside down
$250 → chat picks my hair dye color and i do it ON STREAM
$400 → 1 hour of chat-picked songs, no skipping (please be nice)
$600 → i vlog a grocery pickup the pantry sets up

**what we're playing:**
first half is community lobbies, anyone can join, i'll drop the code. second half chat votes on a new game every 2 hrs. no repeat maps larry i promise

**no card? u can still help:**
• drop canned or boxed food in the blue bin by the pantry's side door, saturdays 9 to 1
• just hang out in chat, it helps more than u think
• share the link with ur family/friends

also even $3 is like 12 lbs of food, that's real. and if u can't give anything that's completely fine, i just want u there. nobody's gonna get called out or anything

and i get it, some ppl think charity streams are cringe and honestly fair, some of them are. but this is basically a normal stream except the money goes to a pantry down the road and u might get to pick my hair color. i'll take a little cringe for that lol

pinning this. see u the 21st 🫡
